idea-plugin.name: Maekom API Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Maekom API Runner — Built-in multi-step API scenario chaining & runner for IntelliJ IDEA with Spring Boot PSI auto-sampling.
IntelliJ IDEA 내장 다단계 API 시나리오 체이닝 & 실행기 (Spring Boot PSI 자동 샘플링 지원)

Key Features / 주요 기능:
  • 🌶️ Multi-Step API Chaining & Auto-Sampling: Chili gutter markers on Spring controllers auto-sample @RequestParam/@ModelAttribute/@RequestBody DTOs & records, chain responses via one-click JsonPath extraction, and enforce Fail-Fast (컨트롤러 고추 아이콘 자동 샘플링, JsonPath 원클릭 변수 추출 및 Fail-Fast 체이닝)
  • 🌍 Environment Profiles & Ignore SSL: Persistent Local (auto-detected server.port) and DEV/STG/PRD profiles (.maekom/environments.json) with self-signed HTTPS ignore (환경별 BaseURL 영속 전환 및 SSL 무시)
  • 🌐 Layered Variables & Common Headers: 8 live dynamic variables ({{$kstNow}}, {{$uuid}}, etc.), extracted variables, project Global Variables, Scenario Variables, Local Secrets, Bulk JSON Import & duplicate validator (동적·추출·전역·시나리오·시크릿 계층 관리, JSON 일괄 입력 및 중복 검증)
  • 🗂️ Folder-Based Scenario Tree Manager: Organize scenarios into nested folders under .maekom/scenarios/ (100% compatible with legacy root JSON files) with Drag & Drop moves/reordering, Base Info (Name/Description) editing, Import/Export & 30s Auto-Save (폴더 기반 시나리오 트리, 드래그 앤 드롭 이동·정렬, Base Info 편집 및 스마트 자동 저장)
  • 📋 One-Click cURL, KO/EN Switch & Updates: Copy single-step or full-scenario cURL, toggle 한국어 | English on IntelliJ's native ToolWindow title bar, and open Settings > Plugins directly from the update button (cURL 복사, 네이티브 타이틀 바 한/영 전환 및 업데이트 설정 즉시 이동)

License: Apache License, Version 2.0 (maekom-hub/maekom-api-runner)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v0.3.0

  • Folder-Based Scenario Manager: Added tree explorer dialog (ScenarioExplorerDialog) with compact AllIcons toolbar, empty folder preservation, bidirectional folder & scenario Drag & Drop (including root drop on empty space + circular/collision guards), and Base Info (Name/Description) editing with 100% backward compatibility for existing .maekom/scenarios/*.json files.
  • Settings > Plugins Update Button Fix: Fixed the native ToolWindow title bar Check Updates / Update Available button to reliably open Settings > Plugins via ModalityState.any().
  • Slimmer Docs: Streamlined README.md and plugin description around core workflows.
